commands.command:
set -eu
ROOT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work"
test "$(git -C "$ROOT" branch --show-current)" = "agent-work"
test -z "$(git -C "$ROOT" status --porcelain)"
git -C "$ROOT" fetch origin main
test "$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse origin/main)" = "4c2694dc9623873782de326cbefdf7e8b94c4bdb"
git -C "$ROOT" merge --ff-only origin/main
test "$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "4c2694dc9623873782de326cbefdf7e8b94c4bdb"
echo "MAC_AGENT_WORK_SYNCED=$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse HEAD)"
commands.output:

Already up to date.
MAC_AGENT_WORK_SYNCED=4c2694dc9623873782de326cbefdf7e8b94c4bdb

commands.command:
set -eu
KEY="$HOME/.ssh/id_ed25519"
ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 michal@192.168.0.23 'bash -s' <<'PI_SCRIPT'
set -eu
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "09be8c4ef70a30791de2698c1c39779e4ab544eb"
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "4c2694dc9623873782de326cbefdf7e8b94c4bdb"
test "$(git diff --name-only HEAD origin/main)" = "docs/GOLDEN_STATUS.md"
git merge --ff-only origin/main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "4c2694dc9623873782de326cbefdf7e8b94c4bdb"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
test "$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html | awk '{print $1}')" = "ccc80c6f664853030e4674dfc783ec1607a9923e823b10f35b221a7348e48a1d"
test "$(systemctl show photomap.service --property MainPID --value)" = 3797751
test "$(systemctl show cloudflared.service --property MainPID --value)" = 222848
curl -fsS --max-time 12 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health -o /dev/null
curl -fsS --max-time 12 http://127.0.0.1:8000/ -o /tmp/photomap-unified-ux-postsync.html
grep -q '/assets/public-map-DWDElC8J.js' /tmp/photomap-unified-ux-postsync.html
echo "PI_MAIN_SYNCED=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "PI_DEPLOY_INDEX_SHA256=$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html | awk '{print $1}')"
echo DOC_ONLY_SYNC_PUBLIC_RUNTIME_INTACT
PI_SCRIPT
